selected_script.angle: sticky yellow grease film on a roasting tray resistant to regular dish soap
selected_script.hook: Fingers touching a sticky grease film on a metal roasting tray where regular dish soap suds slide off without cutting the grease.

script_record.creator_profile: Non-Asian female creator in her early 30s, casual home kitchen setting, warm under-cabinet LED lighting
script_record.segment_01_vo: I scrubbed this roasting tray twice with regular dish soap, and this sticky grease film wouldn't budge. That's when I grabbed NUAN Heavy Duty Degreaser Spray.
script_record.segment_02_vo: Just spray the dense foam right over the grease stains and let it sit. It has a light peach scent and cuts through stubborn kitchen oil fast.
script_record.segment_03_vo: One wipe with a cleaning towel and the sticky residue lifts off completely without hard scrubbing. Look how clean and grease-free the surface looks now!
